recentItems.title: 20 Singers vs Leigh-Anne Pinnock: Who’s The Chosen One? Ft. Nella, Harry & Darkest
recentItems.description:
“You sound like Adele’s younger brother”

20 singers, one shot and one opportunity to become The Chosen One but who will be crowned winner?

Our 4.0 residents Nella Rose, Darkest & HP are joined by multi award winning artist and Little Mixer Leigh-Anne Pinnock to whittle our musicians from 20 down to 1, but who has the stage presence, tonality and full package Leigh-anne’s looking for? 

Expect riff-offs, phenomenal freestyles and faultless falsettos, but who will sing their way to stardom? Hit play now for ALL NEW The Chosen One!
